source_summary: A sparse Chinese landscape with distant low hills across water, a sheer rocky cliff on the right, a flowering tree rising from a foreground rock mass, a small skiff with two figures, and quiet water washes. Calligraphy, seals, border, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: distant_hills_shoreline
motifs.description: Isolate the low horizontal band of distant mountains and shoreline across the left and middle distance, including the pale waterline that tapers toward the right.
must_preserve: soft gray ink wash forming layered low hills
dry-brush horizontal shoreline strokes
small dark angular peaks at far left
thin receding waterline toward the right
subtle tonal gradation separating land from blank water

motifs.name: upper_right_cliff_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the upper portion of the steep right-hand cliff with clustered dark pine-like foliage along its rim and face.
must_preserve: vertical rocky cliff contour at the right edge
angular ink texture strokes on the rock face
dense stippled dark foliage along the upper ridge
dry-brush gray wash inside rock planes
irregular broken edge where cliff meets the blank sky

motifs.name: mid_right_cliff_overhang
motifs.description: Isolate the middle right cliff section with the dark recessed overhang, jagged rock ledges, and clumped shrubs; exclude the flowering tree branches where they cross nearby.
must_preserve: dark shadowed cleft under the projecting rock
jagged ink outlines defining ledges
short clustered shrub strokes on the cliff surface
layered gray wash modeling the vertical rock
rough dry-brush texture along the descending face

motifs.name: flowering_branch_canopy
motifs.description: Isolate the spreading canopy of the flowering tree, including the left sweeping branch, upper central branching, and rightward twig network with red-orange blossoms.
must_preserve: fine branching black ink linework
small red-orange blossom dots and clusters
pale leaf washes around some blossoms
asymmetrical leftward sweeping branch silhouette
delicate twig endings and sparse open spacing

motifs.name: twin_tree_trunks
motifs.description: Isolate the paired twisting trunks and major lower limbs of the flowering tree, from the split trunk down to the roots at the rocky base.
must_preserve: twisting double-trunk structure
dark ink contour lines with pale brown wash
visible knots and bends in the trunks
forking lower branches connecting to the canopy
root-like base merging into the rock and shrubs

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_shore
motifs.description: Isolate the large foreground rock mass on the lower right, including its boulders, ledges, root base, and dark shrub clusters, but not the boat.
must_preserve: large pale gray boulder faces with dry-brush texture
dark ink cracks and angular rock contours
dense black shrub clusters around the tree base
stepped ledges descending toward the water
small detached stones at the water edge

motifs.name: skiff_two_figures
motifs.description: Isolate the narrow skiff at lower left with two seated figures, including the long hull, slight bow and stern lift, and tiny colored head accents.
must_preserve: thin elongated boat hull drawn in dark ink
upturned pointed ends of the skiff
two small seated human figures
tiny reddish head or cap accents
simple oar or body-line gestures inside the boat

motifs.name: calm_lower_water
motifs.description: Isolate the quiet lower water surface around the boat and foreground shore, including horizontal washes, ripples, reflections, and small stones, while excluding solid rock masses and the skiff if used separately.
must_preserve: pale horizontal gray wash bands
thin ink ripple lines near the shore
soft reflection-like strokes below the boat area
small scattered stone marks in the lower water
subtle fading edges that dissolve into blank paper

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
